title: New Scientist is 70 years old – join us in celebrating | New Scientist
description: From a look back at the past 70 years of scientific discovery to a flash forward to the end of the century, we have a host of celebrations for our 70th anniversary
author: Sam Wong

title: The real reasons we keep seeing big tech outages – it isn't just hackers | New Scientist
description: In a single week, banks, an air traffic control system, millions of email accounts and spy agency systems have suffered outages. But speculation about an AI hacking spree or a coordinated attack by a foreign power are wide of the mark
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Cannibal giant star caught devouring its companion in super-rare event | New Scientist
description: Astronomers have caught a giant star in the act of expanding and engulfing another star, and the process is more complex than anyone realised
author: Leah Crane

title: Quantum trick lets you share your location super securely | New Scientist
description: A new experiment demonstrates how quantum devices could verify a person’s position extremely securely, making it much harder to hack sensitive messages.
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan

title: Homo erectus survived on mainland Asia 215,000 years longer than we thought | New Scientist
description: Fossil evidence had suggested Homo erectus, the first hominin species to leave Africa, had vanished from mainland Asia by about 400,000 years ago, but now we know it was still present in the area far more recently
author: Michael Marshall

title: Laser weapons have come of age and are making their way to the battlefield | New Scientist
description: Improved technology has allowed for the creation of more effective laser weapons, and the soaring use of cheap but effective drones in modern conflicts provides a powerful case for why militaries will want such weapons
author: Matthew Sparkes
